subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

Lead paint is an environmental ________ (danger) and can harm children.
solution:
The correct answer is: Hazard.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"danger"** means the possibility of suffering harm or injury. (खतरा)

 
 
• **Example: **There is a **danger **of falling rocks on this trail.
 
 
 
• **"Hazard"** refers to something that can cause harm or danger. (संकट)
 
 
• **Example: **Wet floors are a common **hazard **in workplaces.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'danger'** is **'hazard'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Conflict **(संघर्ष): A serious disagreement or argument.

 
 
• **Example:** The **conflict **between the two countries lasted for years.
 
 
 
• **Empathy **(सहानुभूति): The ability to understand and share the feelings of another.
 
 
• **Example: **She showed **empathy **towards the victims of the disaster.
 
 
 
• **Toil** (कठिन परिश्रम): Hard and continuous work.
 
 
• **Example:** He **toiled **for hours under the hot sun.
